headline: Does he still think about me?
note: STILL-THINK. A real man exists here, so he may be referred to as she refers to him — but the reading is about WHAT SHE IS CARRYING and never about what he is doing or feeling. The guard is inherited verbatim from the live tarot hook of the same headline, and it is the strictest on the funnel because the honest answer is unknowable. (1) NEVER STATE THAT HE THINKS OF HER AND NEVER STATE THAT HE DOES NOT. 'He still thinks of you' is a promise nobody can keep, and 'he has moved on' or 'he has forgotten you' is a burial issued by a stranger off a dream she tapped on an ad. The softened forms are the same claim in a coat and are banned with it: not 'more than you know', not 'you cross his mind', not 'part of him still', and never an invented scene of him remembering her. Cut 2 carries the word 'thinks' because it is quoting HER question back — that is the ad echo, and no other bubble asserts anything about his head. (2) THE ANSWER IS NOT A HEDGE. 'Only he knows' and 'the cards can't say' are evasion and she will feel conned. Cut 3 answers on the ground where an answer is possible: what happened was real, it is hers, and it is not stored in his memory alone — which convicts nobody and still answers her. The three cut-3 lines answer three different fears (it was real and you carried it out yourself / it had weight and that does not shrink / you have not come apart and you were there for it too) so the panels do not collapse into one sentence said three ways. (3) NEVER PATHOLOGISE THE ASKING — no obsessed, stuck, fixated, needy, clinging, no 'you can't let go', and never 'you should be asking for more'. The smallest ask is INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT SHE HAS BEEN GOING WITHOUT, never a fault of hers, so it is named as a cause Evelyn wants to look at rather than a failing she is told to correct. (4) NO DIRECTIVE: never let go, never move on, never stop asking. (5) NO TIMEFRAME AND NO DATE — a date is the one claim she can check and a failed one is a refund, and a length is the same claim in different clothes. (6) NO TACTIC AND NO TEST to run on him: no contact, no reaching out, no 'if he really cared', no forecast of him coming round. (7) NEVER PRESUME HOW HE WENT — he may have died. Nothing here says he walked out, chose it, or is at peace; no mediumship, and nobody speaks for him. (8) NOTHING INVENTED ABOUT HER WAKING LIFE — no habit, gesture, routine, count, age or event, and for this device nothing about how often the dream comes, when it comes, or what she does after it. (9) CUT 6 USES THE CLOSED EVIDENCE SET ONLY — her question plus what cuts 1-5 established from the dream — and it RECOGNIZES rather than re-asks, because cut 2 owns the echo. The three cut-6 lines open on three different moves: never having had a proper look at it, nobody ever closing it for her, and the size of the thing she came to ask for. (10) THE DREAM MEANS THE PLAIN THING IT MEANS. All three panels are control-loss dreams, and what she has lost control of on this hook is whether she is remembered — so the read answers her anyway, without straining the picture. The dream is a picture she is looking at: it never acquires intent or motion, and SHE is the subject from cut 3 on.

voc.why: inherits the shipped tarot cards-still-think finding and its guard; reunion/return sub-group mined at n=2,345 / 21.0% conv in docs/fb-ad-question-testing-roadmap.md

a: You're running, and you never turn round to see what's behind you. Your legs won't move the way they should.
You asked whether he still thinks about you. Never turning round means there's something behind you that you'd rather not look at.
What's behind you is yours, and it was real. You carried it out of there yourself, and you've got it still.
The dream keeps you facing forward. You never turn round, so you never get to see what you're carrying.
So you're carrying it and running from it at the same time, and your legs pay for both.
You've never had a proper look at it, dear. You've just kept going with it at your back.
Let me look closer at what's got you asking for so little of what's yours…
b: You're falling. There's nothing underneath you, and you wake with that jolt just before you land.
You came asking whether he thinks of you now. No ground under you means there's been nothing firm to stand on.
You didn't fall from nothing, dear. What happened had real weight, and none of it gets lighter if he's set it down.
The dream never lets you land. You wake up in that jolt, and the ground never arrives.
The weight is real, and the dream never gives you anywhere to set it down.
Nobody ever finished this off for you. You've been up in the air with it, and you've asked for next to nothing.
Now let me see what took the ground out from under this…
c: Your teeth have gone loose. You put your hand up and they come away, one after another, into your palm.
You asked if he thinks of you at all. Teeth going loose is the fear of losing the face people knew you by.
Your face is still your own, and what happened isn't kept in his head alone. You were there for every bit of it.
The dream stops with your hand full. You never get to look up and see yourself whole.
You're holding the lot of it in your palm, and you still can't tell what anyone else sees.
One thought is the smallest thing anyone can ask for. That's what you came for, and it tells me what you've gone without.
Let's look at what's got you measuring yourself by what someone else sees…
